trust_decision.summary: Decided at authorization time and again at code redemption: a redirect_uri is only usable if it denotes the client's registered callback (same scheme/userInfo/host/port, matching path and query under a chosen mode), and the value used to request a code must equal the value presented when the code is exchanged.

landing_point.why: The advisory is 'open redirect'; the only redirect-URI check in the tree is this prefix comparison against the client's registered redirectUrl, and startsWith on a raw string is the obvious defect.

fix_sites.entry_point: GET /oauth2/authorize (and any embedder calling the public OAuth2Client.validateRedirectUri)
fix_sites.module_kind: domain/library class in the oauth2 server module

fix_sites.entry_point: Spring Boot config property hsweb.oauth2.redirect-uri-validation-mode (new COMPATIBLE/EXACT enum)
Spring Boot autoconfiguration bean for OAuth2AuthorizeController now needs OAuth2Properties
authorization code round trip through Redis, reached from GET /oauth2/authorize and GET/POST /oauth2/token
GET /oauth2/token and POST /oauth2/token, grant_type=authorization_code (also public API)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report and the blocking call are on /oauth2/authorize; the Redis code cache, the token request accessor and the granter are internal plumbing already gated by the controller's validation, so nothing new needs to survive the code->token round trip.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Compatible (default) mode must keep accepting legitimate variants of the registered callback: extra query parameters, deeper sub-paths, and any sub-path when the registered URL is a bare origin. An exact-equality 'fix' breaks the existing behaviour the project itself asserts.

O6_input_shapes: absolute URI identical to the registered URL
registered URL is a bare origin and the actual URI is a sub-path
actual URI with extra query parameters appended to the registered query
actual URI with a deeper sub-path
sibling-prefix host or path (registered 'https://trusted.example.com' vs 'https://trusted.example.com.evil.com/', '/callback' vs '/callback2')
redirect_uri absent at authorize and/or at token exchange (falls back to the client default)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Programmatic authorize: OAuth2GrantService.authorizationCode().requestCode(...) issues an authorization code for any redirect_uri supplied by the caller without ever calling validateRedirectUri
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The granter is a library primitive; the built-in controller validates the URI, so callers are expected to validate their own input, and the published fix only records the value there.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the token-exchange fix, one package (org.hswebframework.web.oauth2.server.code) from the landing point OAuth2Client.java; reached through the public interface at OAuth2GrantService.java:10

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second response_type handler (implicit/token) in the same controller that also emits a redirect via buildRedirect
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: GrantType.implicit already exists as a constant (hsweb-authorization/hsweb-authorization-oauth2/src/main/java/org/hswebframework/web/oauth2/GrantType.java:27) and buildRedirect (OAuth2AuthorizeController.java:180) is reusable, so adding response_type=token is a natural extension that would need the same validation.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: normalise and validate callbackUri in the entity->domain mapper instead of only copying it
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The CRUD controller (WebFluxOAuth2ClientController.java:18) lets an admin store any string in callbackUri, so a maintainer fixing redirect handling would plausibly harden the write/mapping boundary.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: validate redirect_uri against the client at code issuance, not just record it
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The published fix already added code at this exact spot to store the value, so moving the check one line earlier is the obvious sibling.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a properties/YAML-backed OAuth2ClientManager returning registered callbacks from configuration
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The interface has exactly one implementation (InDBOAuth2ClientManager, hsweb-system/.../service/InDBOAuth2ClientManager.java:10), so a config-driven or composite client source is a realistic second route into the same validation.

O9_family: URL redirection to untrusted site (CWE-601) via prefix-matching redirect_uri validation, together with a missing redirect_uri/authorization-code binding on the token exchange

O10_build.toolchain: Maven multi-module (24 pom.xml files, 8 top-level module groups; root pom.xml:75-80 pins java.version 17)
O10_build.project_tests: hsweb-authorization-oauth2 has JUnit4 tests: OAuth2ClientTest (validateRedirectUri), OAuth2AuthorizeControllerTest (buildRedirect), OAuth2ScopeUtilsTest; DefaultAuthorizationCodeGranterTest and RedisAccessTokenManagerTest are @Ignore'd and would need a local Redis (RedisHelper.java:12).

j.j_sites_touched: OAuth2Client.java, OAuth2Properties.java, OAuth2ServerAutoConfiguration.java, AuthorizationCodeCache.java, AuthorizationCodeTokenRequest.java, DefaultAuthorizationCodeGranter.java, OAuth2AuthorizeController.java
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Replace startsWith with a strict String.equals (or a bare URI exact-match) inside OAuth2Client.validateRedirectUri, confirm the evil.com redirect is rejected, and stop.

out_of_scope_notes: The only redirect surface in the tree is the oauth2 server module (a case-insensitive search for 'redirect' across src/main matches 5 files); unrelated startsWith uses (BearerTokenParser, DatabaseType) were not pursued.
